mapper.select: SELECT send_status AS sendStatus, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS userCount FROM notice_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 AND send_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY send_status

SELECT nr.user_id AS userId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.name AS name, r.role_code AS role, p.college_id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, p.class_id AS classId, sc.name AS className, nr.send_status AS sendStatus, nr.round_no AS roundNo, nr.sent_at AS sentAt FROM notice_record nr JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = nr.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_semester_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN college c ON c.id = p.college_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = p.class_id AND sc.deleted = 0 WHERE nr.task_id = #{taskId} AND nr.deleted = 0 AND nr.send_status IN ('unauthorized', 'failed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_record c2 WHERE c2.task_id = nr.task_id AND c2.user_id = nr.user_id AND c2.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c2.deleted = 0) ORDER BY nr.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notice_record nr WHERE nr.task_id = #{taskId} AND nr.deleted = 0 AND nr.send_status IN ('unauthorized', 'failed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_record c2 WHERE c2.task_id = nr.task_id AND c2.user_id = nr.user_id AND c2.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c2.deleted = 0)

SELECT nr.user_id AS userId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.name AS name, r.role_code AS role, p.college_id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, p.class_id AS classId, sc.name AS className, nr.round_no AS roundNo, nr.sent_at AS sentAt, nr.send_status AS sendStatus, (SELECT MAX(c3.confirmed_at) FROM notice_record c3 WHERE c3.task_id = nr.task_id AND c3.user_id = nr.user_id AND c3.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c3.deleted = 0) AS confirmedAt FROM notice_record nr JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = nr.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_semester_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN college c ON c.id = p.college_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = p.class_id AND sc.deleted = 0 WHERE nr.task_id = #{taskId} AND nr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY nr.user_id, nr.round_no
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notice_record nr WHERE nr.task_id = #{taskId} AND nr.deleted = 0
